# Third-party libraries (vendored so the app works offline)

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alphatab/alphaTab.min.js` | [alphaTab](https://alphatab.net) – renders Guitar Pro / MusicXML tabs | 1.9.0 | MPL-2.0 (`alphatab/LICENSE`) |
| `alphatab/font/Bravura.*` | [Bravura](https://github.com/steinbergmedia/bravura) music font | – | SIL OFL 1.1 (`alphatab/font/Bravura-OFL.txt`) |
| `signalsmith-stretch.mjs` | [Signalsmith Stretch](https://signalsmith-audio.co.uk/code/stretch/) – pitch-preserving tempo | 1.3.2 | MIT |
| `jszip.min.js` | [JSZip](https://stuk.github.io/jszip/) – opens song .zip files | 3.10.2 | MIT / GPLv3 (`jszip-LICENSE.md`) |

alphaTab asks that its "alphaTab.net" attribution in the rendered tab stays visible.
